title: Agent panes: modal popup storm blocks input
description: notify_header.sh uses a modal 'tmux display-popup -E ... sleep 4' which grabs the keyboard. Combined with debugger.sh/tester.sh piping interactive claude through 'tee' (claude sees a non-TTY stdout, exits immediately, restart loop fires every 15s), this produces a popup on top of the workspace every few seconds and makes the session unusable.

title: Drop sync.sh: leave branch management to the user
description: scripts/sync.sh rebases between features/<name> and test/<name>, and the agent instructions/docs assume those branches exist. Remove the script and the branch-per-role workflow so agents operate on whatever branch the user has checked out.

title: Add peer-to-peer agent messaging (scripts/msg.sh)
description: Agents can currently only talk along fixed edges: dispatch.sh (->developer), notify.sh (->orchestrator), and debugger.md hand-rolls raw tmux send-keys to reach the tester. Ad-hoc questions between any two roles have no supported path. Add scripts/msg.sh <to-role> <message> that resolves any pane by @role, stamps the sender role from the calling pane, and document it in all four agent files + README.
close_reason: Implemented scripts/msg.sh; documented in all four agent files and README
